title: Part (4 parts)
spec:
Create a new coordinate system for the first part, setting Euler angles to zero degrees and the translation vector to zero. Begin by drawing the first two-dimensional sketch on the first face. In the first loop, draw ten lines to form an L-shaped profile. The lines start from the origin (0.0, 0.0) and proceed to (0.0157, 0.0), then to (0.0262, 0.0), and continue forming the L-shape until returning to the origin. Repeat this process on the second face, creating another L-shaped profile starting from (0.7238, 0.0) and following similar steps to complete the loop. Scale the entire sketch by a factor of 0.75. Transform the sketch into three dimensions by rotating it using the same Euler angles and translating it with the same vector. Extrude the sketch 0.2675 units along the normal direction to create a new solid body. The final dimensions are 0.75 units in length, 0.0472 units in width, and 0.2675 units in height.

For the second part, create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees and a translation vector of (0.0262, 0.0157, 0.0). Draw the first two-dimensional sketch on the first face. In the first loop, draw six lines to form a rectangular profile starting from the origin (0.0, 0.0) and ending at (0.708, 0.0157). Scale the entire sketch by a factor of 0.708. Transform the sketch into three dimensions using the same Euler angles and translation vector. Extrude the sketch 0.0052 units along the normal direction and add the extruded shape to the existing body. The final dimensions are 0.708 units in length, 0.0157 units in width, and 0.0052 units in height.

For the third part, create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees and a translation vector of (0.0262, 0.0, 0.0). Draw the first two-dimensional sketch on the first face. In the first loop, draw four lines to form a rectangular profile starting from the origin (0.0, 0.0) and ending at (0.6976, 0.0157). Repeat this process on the second face, creating another rectangular profile starting from (0.0, 0.0315) and following similar steps to complete the loop. Scale the entire sketch by a factor of 0.6976. Transform the sketch into three dimensions using the same Euler angles and translation vector. Extrude the sketch 0.0157 units along the normal direction to create a new solid body. The final dimensions are 0.6976 units in length, 0.0472 units in width, and 0.0157 units in height.

For the fourth part, create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees and a translation vector of (0.0157, 0.0157, 0.0). Draw the first two-dimensional sketch on the first face. In the first loop, draw four lines to form a small rectangular profile starting from the origin (0.0, 0.0) and ending at (0.0105, 0.0157). On the second face, draw six lines to form a larger rectangular profile starting from (0.0105, 0.0) and ending at (0.7185, 0.0157). Scale the entire sketch by a factor of 0.7185. Transform the sketch into three dimensions using the same Euler angles and translation vector. Extrude the sketch 0.0052 units along the normal direction to create a new solid body. The final dimensions are 0.7185 units in length, 0.0157 units in width, and 0.0052 units in height.

import cadquery as cq

# Part 1: L-shaped CAD model
part1 = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .moveTo(0.0, 0.0)
    .lineTo(0.0157, 0.0)
    .lineTo(0.0262, 0.0)
    .lineTo(0.0262, 0.0157)
    .lineTo(0.0157, 0.0157)
    .lineTo(0.0157, 0.0315)
    .lineTo(0.0262, 0.0315)
    .lineTo(0.0262, 0.0472)
    .lineTo(0.0157, 0.0472)
    .lineTo(0.0, 0.0472)
    .close()
    .moveTo(0.7238, 0.0)
    .lineTo(0.7343, 0.0)
    .lineTo(0.75, 0.0)
    .lineTo(0.75, 0.0472)
    .lineTo(0.7343, 0.0472)
    .lineTo(0.7238, 0.0472)
    .lineTo(0.7238, 0.0315)
    .lineTo(0.7343, 0.0315)
    .lineTo(0.7343, 0.0157)
    .lineTo(0.7238, 0.0157)
    .close()
    .extrude(0.2675)
)

# Part 2: Cylinder connecting the L-shaped model
part2 = (
    cq.Workplane("XY", origin=(0.0262, 0.0157, 0.0))
    .moveTo(0.0, 0.0)
    .lineTo(0.6976, 0.0)
    .lineTo(0.708, 0.0)
    .lineTo(0.708, 0.0157)
    .lineTo(0.6976, 0.0157)
    .close()
    .extrude(0.0052)
)

# Part 3: Another L-shaped model
part3 = (
    cq.Workplane("XY", origin=(0.0262, 0.0, 0.0))
    .moveTo(0.0, 0.0)
    .lineTo(0.6976, 0.0)
    .lineTo(0.6976, 0.0157)
    .lineTo(0.0, 0.0157)
    .close()
    .moveTo(0.0, 0.0315)
    .lineTo(0.6976, 0.0315)
    .lineTo(0.6976, 0.0472)
    .lineTo(0.0, 0.0472)
    .close()
    .extrude(0.0157)
)

# Part 4: Another cylinder
part4 = (
    cq.Workplane("XY", origin=(0.0157, 0.0157, 0.0))
    .moveTo(0.0, 0.0)
    .lineTo(0.0105, 0.0)
    .lineTo(0.0105, 0.0157)
    .lineTo(0.0, 0.0157)
    .close()
    .moveTo(0.0105, 0.0)
    .lineTo(0.708, 0.0)
    .lineTo(0.7185, 0.0)
    .lineTo(0.7185, 0.0157)
    .lineTo(0.708, 0.0157)
    .close()
    .extrude(0.0052)
)

# Combine all parts into the final model
r = part1.union(part2).union(part3).union(part4)

import cadquery as cq

# U-channel parameters
L = 0.75      # length in X
W = 0.0472    # depth in Y
H = 0.2675    # height in Z
t = 0.0225    # wall thickness

# Sketch U-profile in the XZ plane (local x = X, local y = Z)
r = (
    cq.Workplane("XZ")
    .moveTo(0, 0)
    .lineTo(L, 0)
    .lineTo(L, H)
    .lineTo(L - t, H)
    .lineTo(L - t, t)
    .lineTo(t, t)
    .lineTo(t, 0)
    .close()
    .extrude(W)
)

import cadquery as cq

# Overall dimensions
L = 0.7500   # X
W = 0.0472   # Y
H = 0.2675   # Z

# Estimated feature thicknesses from the views
end_t = 0.030    # thickness of the two vertical end legs along X
base_t = 0.020   # thickness of the bottom rail along Z

# Bottom rail
base = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .moveTo(0, 0)
    .lineTo(L, 0)
    .lineTo(L, W)
    .lineTo(0, W)
    .close()
    .extrude(base_t)
)

# Left vertical end leg
left = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .moveTo(0, 0)
    .lineTo(end_t, 0)
    .lineTo(end_t, W)
    .lineTo(0, W)
    .close()
    .extrude(H)
)

# Right vertical end leg
right = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .moveTo(L - end_t, 0)
    .lineTo(L, 0)
    .lineTo(L, W)
    .lineTo(L - end_t, W)
    .close()
    .extrude(H)
)

r = base.union(left).union(right)
